newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes steady in routine trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes steady in routine trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished little changed against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday.
It ended at T$27.481 against T$27.483 at Monday's close. Turnover totalled US$269.5 million, compared to Monday's US$296.5 million.

From a soft opening, the Taiwan dollar inched up on light buying by exporters and foreign funds. The U.S. dollar's pause in its advance against other major currencies also lent support to the Taiwan dollar, said a foreign bank dealer.
"The volume is decent," the dealer said. "But it's hard to imagine the Taiwan dollar making any breakthrough out of this tight range."
For the present, the only stimulus came from the U.S. dollar's fluctuations against other currencies, especially the yen, she said. -- Nailene Chou Wiest (2-5080815)
